summary: The review page's content anchors. anchors: goldens from running review.js fnv1a/norm in a JS engine (node); 'h' + FNV-1a over UTF-16 units with JS float64 arithmetic, of the whitespace-collapsed, lowercased heading and text joined by U+0000. labels: review.js labelFor, 70 UTF-16 units at most. page: every element the review layer makes markable on one page, in document order, with its anchor, section heading (data-ox-section, else the first h2 or h3 at any depth, else the section id) and label; a section and its one item with the same text share an anchor.
